shortDescription: NetApp E-Series manage email notification settings

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: api_url
options.description: The url to the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API. Example https://prod-1.wahoo.acme.com/devmgr/v2

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the SANtricity Web Services Proxy or Embedded Web Services API.

options.name: contact
options.description: Allows the owner to specify some free-form contact information to be included in the emails. This is typically utilized to provide a contact phone number.

options.name: log_path
options.description: Path to a file on the Ansible control node to be used for debug logging

options.name: recipients
options.description: The email addresses that will receive the email notifications. Required when I(state=enabled).

options.name: sender
options.description: This is the sender that the recipient will see. It doesn't necessarily need to be a valid email account. Required when I(state=enabled).

options.name: server
options.description: A fully qualified domain name, IPv4 address, or IPv6 address of a mail server. To use a fully qualified domain name, you must configure a DNS server on both controllers using M(netapp_eseries.santricity.netapp_e_mgmt_interface). Required when I(state=enabled).

options.name: ssid
options.description: The ID of the array to manage. This value must be unique for each array.

options.name: state
options.description: Enable/disable the sending of email-based alerts.

options.name: test
options.description: When a change is detected in the configuration, a test email will be sent. This may take a few minutes to process. Only applicable if I(state=enabled).
